description: Unit test class for VcapServicesStringSupplier, testing its behavior under different environment variable conditions, including file path retrieval, immutability, and exception handling when reading VCAP services JSON.

classes.name: VcapServicesStringSupplierTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the VcapServicesStringSupplier, verifying environment variable handling, file reading, and immutability.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by locating the JSON test resource and setting the file path.

methods.name: setVcapConfigFileEnvironmentVariable
methods.description: Sets the environment variable to point to the test JSON file before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that VcapServicesStringSupplier is immutable and that Path objects used are also immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWhenVcapLocationSystemEnvWasNotSet
methods.description: Ensures that an exception is thrown if the environment variable for VCAP location is not set.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullPath
methods.description: Tests that passing a null path to 'of' method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the VcapServicesStringSupplier returns a value containing expected content.

methods.name: tryToReadNonExistingFile
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to read a non-existent config file, expecting an exception.
